newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India delays Cochin naphtha tender lifting dates.
newsitem.headline: India delays Cochin naphtha tender lifting dates.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has delayed by a week the lifting dates of its high aromatic naphtha (HAN) cargo from Cochin to July 31-August 2, industry sources said on Wednesday.
"It is to make the product available," a source said.
IOC had originally tendered to sell the 27,000 tonnes HAN cargo between July 27-29.
The tender closes July 17 and is valid for a day.
IOC's last HAN tender from Cochin, offering 30,000-tonnes lifting June 30-July 2, was awarded at a $30-$35 discount to Japanese spot quote on a free-on-board basis.
